mixlogic.format_help_sobe_desce: Fixed pairs. Winners move up a court, losers move down. The pair that ends on court 1 wins.
mixlogic.format_help_sobe_desce_rotate: Partners change every round. At the end, the two players on court 1 win.
mixlogic.format_help_todos_contra_todos: Every pair plays every other pair. If rounds are left over, there are semi-finals and a final.
mixlogic.format_help_grupos_eliminatoria: Group stage first, then knockouts. The pair that wins the final wins the mix.
mixlogic.format_help_americano: Partners change every round and points count per person. Whoever scores most points wins, on their own — there is no winning pair.
gerirclube.pool_size_help: Each group plays round-robin; the top 2 from each group advance to the knockout stage.

onboarding.heading: What's your level?
onboarding.subheading: Set your entry points on the ranking. Choose honestly — from here on, results do the talking.
onboarding.level_n1_description: You play federation tournaments at the top level. You master every shot, including smashes out of the court, and play every point tactically.
onboarding.level_n2_description: You play federation or club tournaments at a high level. Solid bandeja and víbora, good game reading and quick at moving to and from the net.
onboarding.level_n3_description: Advanced club player. You control the back and side walls, place your bandeja and attack high balls.
onboarding.level_n4_description: Strong intermediate. You play several times a week, use the walls with confidence and hold long rallies with few errors.
onboarding.level_n5_description: Intermediate. You play regularly, return most balls off the back wall and are starting to move to the net with purpose.
onboarding.level_n6_description: You've been playing for a few months. You keep the ball in play, but walls and lobs still give you trouble.
onboarding.level_iniciante_description: You're just starting or have played only a few times. Still learning the serve, the rules and playing off the walls.
onboarding.footnote: This choice only sets your starting point — your public level (M6, M5…) evolves with your games.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.subtitle: Quick instructions to get started
instructions.step_open_app: Open the app (or site) on your phone.
instructions.step_create_account_details: Tap <1>Create Account</1>: fill in your name, email, date of birth, gender, and set a password.
instructions.step_create_account: Tap <1>Create account</1> — and you're in! Keep your password safe.
instructions.step_games_list: On the main page, you'll see the list of games.
instructions.step_join_game: To join a game, tap <1>I want to play</1>.
instructions.join_with_partner: If you have a partner: choose <1>Join with partner</1> and confirm their name.
instructions.join_alone: If you don't: choose <1>Join solo</1> — the system tries to find you a partner.
instructions.step_court_capacity: Each mix has <1>courts × 4 players</1> (e.g. 2 courts = 8 players). When it fills up, you'll see <4>Mix closed — court booked</4> and it stops accepting sign-ups.
instructions.step_profile_side: In your <1>Profile</1>, set your <3>preferred side</3> (Left, Right or Either) — it's used to form duplas: whoever joins solo is paired by matching a left player with a right player.
instructions.step_admin_start: Once the mix is full, the admin taps <1>Start the game</1>: duplas are formed, rounds are calculated (court time ÷ game time) and games are drawn across the courts according to the format.
instructions.rule_sobe_desce: <0>Ladder (sobe e desce):</0> whoever wins moves up a court, whoever loses moves down. The mix is won by the dupla that wins on court 1 in the last round.
instructions.rule_todos_contra_todos: <0>Round robin (todos contra todos):</0> each dupla plays every other dupla; if rounds are left over, there's a knockout stage (semifinals / final).
instructions.step_results: During the mix, the admin records the result of <1>each game</1> (there are no draws). In the ladder format, the round only advances once all results are submitted. At the end, the admin taps <3>Finish game</3> and the ranking updates: game wins/losses per player and <5>+1 mix win</5> for the winning dupla.
instructions.tip: <0>💡 Tip:</0> If something doesn't work: take a screenshot and send it via WhatsApp to one of the founders. Save the site link so you can access it easily.
instructions.card_view_games_body: On the home page you'll see all available games. Tap a game to see details.
instructions.card_join_games_body: Choose whether you want to play solo or with a partner. You'll get automatic confirmation.
instructions.card_rankings_body: The ranking shows, per player: <1>mixes won</1> (mix wins) and <4>game wins/losses</4> (each individual game within the mixes).
instructions.card_edit_profile_body: Update your name, contact info and skill level on the profile page.
instructions.admin_create_mix: <0>To create a mix:</0> "Create new game" → set title, date, location, <3>number of courts</3> (players = courts × 4), <5>court time</5>, <8>game time</8> (rounds = court ÷ game) and the <10>format</10> (ladder or round robin).
instructions.admin_start_mix: <0>To start the mix:</0> once it's full, open the game and tap <3>Start the game</3> — duplas and the draw are automatic.
instructions.admin_during_mix: <0>During the mix:</0> record the result of each game, advance the rounds, and at the end tap <2>Finish game</2> to update the ranking.
instructions.admin_manage_members: <0>To manage members:</0> Go to the Admin panel to see all players and promote new admins.
instructions.contact_help: Need help? Contact the group's administrators.
instructions.elo_intro: Your level is computed exclusively from your results — no favours, no points for showing up.
instructions.elo_b1: It goes up when you win and down when you lose — and beating stronger pairs is worth more than beating weaker ones.
instructions.elo_b2: Your pair counts as the average of both players, against the average of the opposing pair.
instructions.elo_b3: You start from your own self-assessment, from level 1 to Beginner — from then on, results do the talking.
instructions.elo_b5: Both mixes and friendly matches count; in friendlies the score must be confirmed by the opposing team.
instructions.elo_b6: In your first 8 games your level is provisional: it moves more with each result (especially the first 3), shows as ~points with the NEW mark on your avatar, and weighs less on your partners' gains/losses until it settles.
instructions.elo_note: The fine details of the formula are tuned by the alinho team as the system matures.
instructions.xp_intro: XP measures dedication, not skill — it only goes up, never down. You earn it like this:
instructions.xp_v2: Each game inside the mix: 5 XP
instructions.xp_v4: Confirmed friendly match: 10 XP (+5 if you win)
instructions.xp_shields_intro: Accumulated XP sets your activity level — 10 levels:
instructions.xp_glow: Your activity level shows on your profile and the Activity ranking — it never goes down, and has no relation to your playing level.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section_intro_body: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data alinho collects, why, and what your rights are. alinho is operated by Alinho (contact: alinhopt@gmail.com). Last updated: 31 August 2026.
privacy.section_data_collected_body: When you create an account, we collect your name, email, birthday, and gender. You can add a profile photo and a phone number — the phone number is never stored in plain text: it's turned into an irreversible hash before it leaves your device, used only to link your account to your club's WhatsApp bot. If you sign in with Google, we receive the name, email, and photo associated with that Google account. While you use the app, we store the games you join, results, your level/ranking, and which clubs you belong to.
privacy.section_purpose_title: What we use your data for
privacy.section_purpose_body: We use your data to manage your account, organize games and rankings, let club admins manage games and members, and — if you enable the WhatsApp bot — to let you confirm attendance for a game over WhatsApp.
privacy.section_visibility_title: What other players see about you
privacy.section_visibility_body: Your name, photo, level and preferred side are always visible to alinho users — in Rankings, in the player search and in the lists of the mixes you join. The rest of your profile (head-to-head, games and stats, clubs and groups) follows your settings in Profile → Privacy: public, friends only (people who follow each other) or private. With a private account, you choose who can follow you. Members of a club or group see who has joined that club's or group's mixes, and whoever manages it also sees the member list and the history of who joined and left each mix. Non-members see a club's public mixes without player names — only how many there are and whether someone they follow is a member. If the club uses the WhatsApp bot, the lists of who has joined, with names, are posted in that club's WhatsApp group.
privacy.section_sharing_body: Your data is stored on Supabase (database and authentication) and the app runs on Vercel (hosting). If you sign in with Google, authentication goes through Google. Your club's WhatsApp bot runs on alinho's own server and uses an unofficial WhatsApp client library — not Meta's official Business API. We don't sell your data to third parties, and the app doesn't use third-party advertising or analytics networks.
privacy.section_cookies_body: The app only uses what's essential to function — keeping your authentication session — and no third-party cookies or tracking technology for advertising or analytics. If that ever changes, the consent banner you see when visiting the site will be updated to reflect that choice.
privacy.section_retention_body: We keep your data for as long as your account is active. If you request account deletion, we delete your personal data, except for records we're legally required to retain.

deleteaccount.hint: Deletes your personal data. You have {{days}} days to change your mind.
deleteaccount.confirm_message: Your account disappears from the app right away: you leave all your groups and nobody can find you. You have {{days}} days to change your mind — just sign in again.
deleteaccount.what_goes: We delete your name, photo, email, phone and all your personal data.
deleteaccount.what_stays: Results of the mixes and games you played stay, under the name "Removed player", so the points of the people who played with you are not affected.
deleteaccount.confirm_emphasis: After {{days}} days it is deleted for good and cannot be undone.

deleteaccount.pending_groups_note: If you recover it, your history and points come back. The groups you were in will need to accept you again.
deleteaccount.recover_error: Could not recover the account. Try again.
deleteaccount.admin_hint: For requests that arrive by email, including players created by the bot who never opened the app. Deleted immediately, no waiting period.
deleteaccount.admin_confirm_message: Personal data disappears now. Mix results stay, under the name "Removed player".
deleteaccount.admin_confirm_emphasis: It is immediate and cannot be undone.
privacy.section_rights_body: You can ask to access, correct or delete your personal data at any time by writing to alinhopt@gmail.com. You can also delete your account in the app, under Profile → Delete my account: it disappears right away and you have 30 days to change your mind; after that your personal data is deleted for good. Results of games you took part in stay, without your name, so other players' points are not changed. Messages already sent in WhatsApp groups stay on the phones of the people who received them and we cannot delete them.
privacy.section_changes_body: If we update this policy in a significant way, we'll let you know inside the app. The date at the top of this page always reflects the latest version.
privacy.section_contact_body: For any question about this policy or about your data, contact us at alinhopt@gmail.com.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section_intro_body: alinho is a padel game management app: clubs create games ('mixes'), players join solo or with a partner, results feed a ranking, and an optional WhatsApp bot lets you confirm attendance without opening the app. By using alinho, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. Last updated: 31 August 2026.
terms.section_pilot_body: alinho is currently in a free pilot phase, with a limited number of clubs. There are no payments or subscriptions. We reserve the right to make changes to the service, including paid features in the future, with advance notice inside the app.
terms.section_responsibilities_body: By creating an account, you agree to provide truthful information (name, birthday, gender) and to play in good faith — not signing up for games without intending to show up, not reporting false results, and treating other players with respect.
terms.section_admins_body: A club admin manages the games, members, and settings of the club(s) they're associated with — not other clubs on the platform. Admins are responsible for keeping club information up to date and handling join requests fairly.
terms.section_whatsapp_body: If your club has the WhatsApp bot enabled, you can confirm attendance for a game by replying "In" or "Out" in the conversation. The bot is optional and operated by alinho — your interaction with it is also subject to the Privacy Policy.
terms.section_liability_body: alinho is provided "as is," during a pilot phase. We don't guarantee continuous service availability and aren't liable for losses resulting from downtime, errors, or decisions made based on data in the app (for example, rankings).
terms.section_changes_body: We may update these terms as alinho evolves. Significant changes will be communicated inside the app.
terms.section_law_body: These terms are governed by Portuguese law.
terms.section_contact_body: For any question about these terms, contact us at alinhopt@gmail.com.
